name: The First Lady's Game
overview: The First Lady Hera refuses to be President Zeus’s pawn and fights for power. Zeus is tangled in the Eden Island sex scandal, rigs elections and colludes with conglomerates for profit. Vice President Hephaestus covets power, plots to overthrow the legitimate president and threatens the Cane family for years. After serving as White House Chief of Staff, Hera runs for president independently, facing deepfake slander, gender discrimination and assassination attempts. She teams up with Athena, head of the Kim Group, and federal agent Mike to gather evidence, promotes the Women's Political Participation Protection Act, and exposes Zeus’s crimes to break gender bias in politics.
